subject: Confirmation of Flight Reservation
body: Dear John, We are pleased to confirm your flight reservation for your upcoming trip to New York. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Departure: Date, Time Arrival: Date, Time Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you onboard. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
